note: Ward County park in Burlington, inside a bend of the Des Lacs River near its confluence with the Souris. The RV sites ring a teardrop loop in the southern meander. --Claude
summary: Ward County page + bookmysites engine: $30 RV (12 sites, 30/50 amp) + $60 group RV site, $20 tent, $3 online fee; showers; May 1-Oct 3 (2026 closed from Sep 10). Water hookup cleared (fill stations only). Platform operator (bookmysites). Riverview is the wrong class: the Des Lacs is 14-20 m wide here (creek); creekside lead for the loop's SW tip. Pin ok.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (stored riverview): the Des Lacs River channel at the campground measures ~14-20 m wide on Esri zoom-19 imagery (west reach ~20 m at 48.2818,-101.4329; south reach ~14 m at 48.2809,-101.4318), so by the size rule it is a creek and 'riverview' is the wrong class (there is no creek-view value). The RV loop sits inside the meander: on the engine's site map sites 5, 6 and 7 are on the south/south-west tip of the teardrop loop; on imagery that tip (about 48.2811,-101.4322) is ~15-25 m from the bank over mown grass with scattered shrubs, while the east side (sites 2-4) and much of the south bank carry a tree band. Sites are sold by the night (every RV site on the engine). Candidate: creekside with a caveat naming sites 5-7, else not waterfront; pad positions are inferred from the engine's schematic map, not surveyed points.

SEASON 2026: the county page banner reads 'Old Settler's Campground is CLOSED for the 2026 Season. See you next year!' and the booking engine blocks every site from 2026-09-10 (some from 2026-08-23/26) with 'Closed for the 2026 Season' - an early end to the published May 1-Oct 3 season, not a closure status (it is now November).
